# What Codex Sees

What Codex receives for each job. Read this before writing a project's `AGENTS.md`: the protocol below (execution rules, self-verification, handoff format, rework rules) is sent with every contract, so `AGENTS.md` only needs what is specific to your project (toolchain and commands, file/dependency boundaries).

| Layer | Source |
|---|---|
| Codex's own system instructions | Codex itself |
| `AGENTS.md` | Loaded by Codex from the job's repository tree (c2c does not inject it) |
| Turn prompt | c2c: the [protocol](#1-protocol-every-job) followed by a [Goal](#2-goal-contract-codex_implement) or [Delta](#4-delta-contract-codex_rework) Contract |
| [Thread-goal objective](#3-thread-goal-objective) | c2c: a compact restatement the `/goal` loop audits before declaring completion (max 2000 chars by default) |

## 1. Protocol (every job)

The fixed first part of every turn prompt, identical for Goal and Delta Contracts.

```markdown
## Protocol Instructions

### Execution Rules
- Implement exactly what the contract specifies. Do not decide or expand what to build.
- Think before coding: surface confusion and tradeoffs instead of assuming.
- Prefer the minimum code that solves the problem. Make surgical changes and do no extra work.
- Follow the target project's declared toolchain. Add tests whenever a Success Condition requires them.

### Self-Verification
Before declaring completion:
1. Run the project's own typecheck/build and test commands, plus every command named in the Success Conditions. All must pass.
2. Walk through every Success Condition and confirm it is met. If one cannot be met, say so explicitly and do not declare completion.
3. Re-read the Constraints and confirm none were violated, including all "Do not modify" lists.

### Required Handoff
End every task with exactly these sections:

### Changed Files
- path — one-line reason

### Validation
- Commands run and their results.

### Success Conditions
- [x]/[ ] Each condition from the contract, with evidence.

### Risks & Deviations
- Known risks, assumptions, and deviations, or "none".

### Rework
For a Delta Contract, fix only its review findings and failed Success Conditions. Do not revisit work that passed review. Repeat the full Self-Verification and Required Handoff.
```

## 2. Goal Contract (`codex_implement`)

Appended after the protocol for a new job. Example contract:

```markdown
## Goal Contract

### Goal
`topWords(text, n)` in src/wordfreq.js returns the n most frequent words as [word, count] pairs, case-insensitive, punctuation ignored, ties broken alphabetically.

### Constraints
- Only modify files needed for this task.

### Success Conditions
- [ ] `npm test` exits 0; test/wordfreq.test.js covers case folding, punctuation, ties, and n <= 0.
- [ ] Deleting the alphabetical tie-break makes `npm test` fail.
```

## 3. Thread-goal objective

Set via `thread/goal/set` for the same job. It is built from `goal` and every `success_condition`; the handoff requirement is appended automatically, so contracts should not list it.

```text
Fulfill this Goal Contract: `topWords(text, n)` in src/wordfreq.js returns the n most frequent words as [word, count] pairs, case-insensitive, punctuation ignored, ties broken alphabetically. The goal is achieved only when every Success Condition is verified: (`npm test` exits 0; test/wordfreq.test.js covers case folding, punctuation, ties, and n <= 0.) (Deleting the alphabetical tie-break makes `npm test` fail.) and a structured handoff (Changed Files / Validation / Success Conditions / Risks & Deviations) has been delivered.
```

## 4. Delta Contract (`codex_rework`)

Appended after the protocol when review fails; sent into the same thread, where the original goal and objective re-engage. Example:

```markdown
## Delta Contract

### Findings
- src/wordfreq.js:12 — `topWords(text, 0)` returns one word; it must return [].

### Failed Success Conditions
- [ ] `npm test` exits 0; test/wordfreq.test.js covers case folding, punctuation, ties, and n <= 0.

### Constraints
- Original constraints still apply. Fix only the findings above; do not touch work that passed.
```
